description: Source code for the NTLM HTTP authentication mechanism implementation in Chromium, including functions for generating authentication tokens, handling challenge parsing, and managing dependencies.

classes.name: HttpAuthNtlmMechanism
classes.description: Implements NTLM authentication mechanism for HTTP, managing challenge/response tokens, and token generation.

methods.name: GetMSTime
methods.description: Returns current time in microseconds multiplied by 10.

methods.name: GenerateRandom
methods.description: Fills a buffer with cryptographically secure random bytes.

methods.name: SetAuthTokenFromBinaryToken
methods.description: Encodes a binary token into a base64 string prefixed with 'NTLM ' and sets it as the auth token.
